response.what_it_is: A bundle of used scrap car metal parts including drive shafts, a steering rack, a radiator, and a starter motor
hidden_risks: Internal mechanical wear or damage in the steering rack and drive shafts
Leaks or internal clogging in the radiator core
Starter motor internal electrical or mechanical failure
response.best_proof: Photo 0 showing the condition and arrangement of all parts in the lot against the wall.
seller_claims_unsupported: Whether individual parts are salvageable for repair or only good for recycling
